summary: Comprehensive first-pass testing of RootMC Mobile Companion PWA. Backend: 31/31 pytest passed (auth /link demo flow, market list/detail sorting/filter, portfolio, checkin claim + wallet increment, vote claim + cooldown, leaderboards, daily report). Frontend: 74/74 UI checks passed after retest (initial 2 failures were retest-timing artifacts — daily-report-card and range-* buttons render after async fetch completes; both verified working). Full user journey works end-to-end: /link demo login (code auto-prefill), navigation across all 5 bottom tabs, market sort/search/detail with range switching, portfolio with net worth + holdings, daily check-in claim with confetti + wallet +10G + cooldown, vote flow (Vote -> Claim -> Cooldown), leaderboards 4 categories, session persistence on reload, logout clears token. Design fidelity confirmed: JetBrains Mono numerics, gold accent, pos #00F58C / neg #FF453A colors, sticky bottom nav with gold underline.

minor.issue: Endpoints mutate `doc` object returned from Motor find_one and modify keys in-place. Non-blocking but future refactor risk if response objects get cached.

`new_wallet_balance` is computed from user object read before the $inc update; if concurrent claims fire, the returned value could be stale. Actual DB value is correct via $inc. Recommend re-reading after update or using find_one_and_update return_document=AFTER.

issues: Countdown text uses `Math.max(0, seconds_until_next - Math.floor((Date.now() - now) / 1000))` but `now` state is refreshed to Date.now() every second, so the subtraction is always ~0 — countdown never decrements visually until page reloads. Minor UX polish.

action_items: Optional: fix stale countdown math in Rewards.jsx CheckInTab (compute against a fixed 'loadedAt' timestamp instead of `now` state).
Optional: return post-update wallet balance from /checkin/claim & /vote/claim using find_one_and_update(return_document=AFTER).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (656 lines) is nearing the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting routers (auth/market/portfolio/rewards) into modules before further growth.

server.py routes mutate documents returned by Motor before serialisation (economy_overview jitters treasury on the fetched doc). Fine today since seeded once, but risky if switched to a cached MotorClient.
Frontend uses `window.location.href = '/more'` in TopBar for the avatar button which triggers a full page reload; should use react-router `navigate('/more')` for SPA feel.

Rewards.jsx VoteTab: `showClaim = pending[s.id] && s.can_claim` — after user votes and claims within same session, s.can_claim remains true briefly (from the site list already loaded) until load() re-fetches — small race window but currently OK because setPending(false) fires immediately.
auth.jsx: refresh() catches errors silently and calls setToken(null); this is correct but could log for debugging.
No debouncing on market-search input; not a bug for 20 items but worth noting for scale.
React Router v6 future flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — cosmetic only.
test_credentials: None required — /link demo mode. Any Minecraft username (3-16 chars) starts the flow; the /auth/link/start endpoint returns the 6-char code which is prefilled in the code input.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup (18 market items, treasury/economy KV, server_status, daily_report, 12 leaderboard players). Test users created during pytest: 'QaBot{ts}', 'TestQA', 'FlowUser', 'Reuse' (harmless demo users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 31 pytest tests + 74 Playwright UI assertions pass. Backend base URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Mobile viewport is 420x900 (max-w-md container). The two initially-failing UI assertions (daily-report-card, range-1H..ALL) were false negatives due to insufficient wait for the async data load and were verified passing on retest. If you re-test, always wait_for_selector on data-dependent elements (they render inside `{data && ...}`). No auth needed for market/leaderboards/economy endpoints; portfolio/checkin/vote require Bearer token from /auth/link/complete.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved issues. Two Playwright transient false-negatives (daily-report-card, market-detail range buttons) were caused by the test asserting element presence immediately after a page navigation instead of waiting for the async fetch to populate. On retest with wait_for_selector, both rendered correctly. This is a testing-script pattern issue, not a product bug.
